card.name: Section cross-references in brackets
card.fires_on: Pieces inside bracketed cross-references such as "[see Boxed Warning, ...]" or "[see Clinical Studies (14.3)]", including the word see, the space or period inside the section number, and the ed in Boxed. Also the hyphen-approved in "FDA-approved tests".
